tha-ap270:1.1: Saḷalapupphiya.] Candabhāgānadītīre ahosiṃ kinnaro tadā / Vipassim addasaṃ *Buddhaṃ raṃsijālasamākulaṃ.* // //
tha-ap270:2.1: Pasannacitto sumano paramāya ca pītiyā / paggayha saḷalaṃ pupphaṃ Vipassim okirim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap270:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjay' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap270:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Saḷalapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
